column1: # The Chinese (Hong Kong) translations: the mesh editor (src/ui_mesh.rs).
Make one and put it on the map with a click (each one can then be edited, scaled, cut and joined)
column2: 建立後點擊地圖放置（每個形狀之後都可編輯、縮放、切割及接合）

column1: Cut away the other side first
Tip: hide the cutting part (its eye in the list) so only the cut shows
column2: 提示：隱藏切割部件（在列表中的眼睛圖示），只顯示切割結果

column1: Every vertex follows the terrain under it (in the editor's view and the written files at the place it stands)
column2: 每個頂點都貼合其下的地形（在編輯器畫面及寫出的檔案中皆依其所處位置）

column1: objects on the map: changes apply to all
column2: 地圖上的物件：變更會套用至全部

column1: Write it as OBJ, glTF / GLB, FBX, Collada, USD, STL, PLY, 3MF, OFF, X or O3D
column2: 寫出為 OBJ、glTF / GLB、FBX、Collada、USD、STL、PLY、3MF、OFF、X 或 O3D

column1: Off: its height is kept above the ground under it
column2: 關閉：保持其高於下方地面的高度

column1: The part edited and given modifiers
column2: 正在編輯並加上修改器的部件

column1: Add a shape as a part
Each part becomes an object of its own, standing where it stood
column2: 每個部件成為獨立物件，保留原來位置

column1: Make it part of the mesh
PNG, JPEG, BMP, TGA, TIFF, WebP or DDS
Light of its own: black for none
column2: 自帶光源：黑色代表沒有

column1: From an .mtl, a glTF / GLB / FBX, or the pictures of one PBR material (base colour, normal, roughness, metal, AO...)
column2: 來自 .mtl、glTF / GLB / FBX，或單一 PBR 材質的 Texture（基礎色、法線、粗糙度、金屬、AO…）

column1: A lamp's bulb, a lit sign: a glow seen at night
column2: 燈泡、亮起的招牌：夜間可見的發光

column1: The pool of light a street lamp throws at night
column2: 街燈在夜間投下的光池

column1: Put it within 40 m of a crossing with a light program: it takes its light from it (or link it in its properties)
column2: 把它放在有燈光程式的路口 40 米內：它會取用該路口的燈光（或在屬性中連結）

column1: Its textures and colours painted into one picture on a new UV map (one material: fewer draws in the game), with its own shadows and its lamps' night light if chosen
column2: 將其 Texture 與顏色繪入一張新 UV 圖上的單一圖片（單一材質：遊戲內繪製次數更少），並可選擇一併烘焙其陰影與燈具夜間光照
燈具夜間光照（光照 Texture）

column1: The object's last change (Ctrl+Z in the edit mode)
column2: 物件的最後一次變更（編輯模式中按 Ctrl+Z）

column1: A copy of this object's type of its own is made for it, with its meshes, materials and lamps to edit; the original stays as it is
column2: 會為它複製一份該物件類型，含其 Mesh、材質與燈具供編輯；原本的維持不變

column1: An openMapper object of its shape beside it, to edit as a mesh (vertices, edges, faces)
column2: 在其旁建立同形狀的 openMapper 物件，以 Mesh 形式編輯（頂點、邊、面）

column1: The same, the spline taken away (its lanes go with it)
column2: 同上，但移除 Spline（其行車線一併移除）

column1: All their parts in the one shown in the properties, the others gone
column2: 將它們的所有部件併入屬性中顯示的那一個，其餘消失

column1: Solid modelling (CSG): the object shown in the properties with the others
column2: 實體建模（CSG）：屬性中顯示的物件與其他物件
透視選取：可直接穿透 Mesh 選取

column1: Click, Shift + click to add, drag on nothing for a box, a second click or Alt + click for a loop
column2: 點擊選取，Shift + 點擊新增，在空白處拖曳框選，再次點擊或 Alt + 點擊選取環狀

column1: Point at an edge and press Ctrl+R
The selection turned round the object's up axis through its middle, in 12 steps
column2: 將選取部分繞物件的中間上軸旋轉，分 12 步

column1: Faces of the selection (all, with none selected); mark seams on edges first for an unwrap by seams
column2: 選取部分的面（未選取時為全部）；要按接縫展開，請先在邊上標記接縫

column1: A pole with a lamp that glows and lights the ground at night
column2: 帶有燈具的燈柱，會發光並在夜間照亮地面

column1: A traffic light of the lamps below that a crossing's light program drives
column2: 下方燈具中的交通燈，由路口的燈光程式驅動

column1: Choose a picture or a texture: it becomes an object you place, move, turn and scale like any other. Several repeats make a pattern
column2: 選擇圖片或 Texture：它會成為一個物件，可像其他物件一樣放置、移動、旋轉及縮放。多重複會組成圖案

column1: A lamp that glows and lights the ground round it
column2: 會發光並照亮周圍地面的燈具

column1: Choose a sound file (.wav): it plays where you put the marker, as far as the radius carries; the marker shows in the editor only
column2: 選擇聲音檔（.wav）：它會在標記所在之處播放，傳送距離以半徑為準；標記只在編輯器中顯示
